intro: The Indian Employment visa is for skilled professionals going to work for a company or organisation in India. There’s no e-Visa for work, so this is the visa you need. We prepare it with you and your employer.
cardText: For skilled professionals taking a job with a company in India.

rules.title: A minimum salary usually applies
rules.text: Employment visas are usually only granted for skilled roles paying more than a set minimum, with some exceptions. We’ll check your offer against the current rules.

rules.title: Register after you arrive
rules.text: Employment visa holders usually need to register with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) within 14 days of arriving.

rules.title: Your passport goes to the visa centre
rules.text: Regular visas are stuck into your passport, so you’ll need to submit it at the Indian visa application centre. Don’t book travel you can’t change until it’s back.

rules.title: Allow more time
rules.text: Regular visas take longer than e-Visas, and much longer for people of Pakistani origin. Apply as early as you can.

boxText: Short business visits don’t need an Employment visa.

sections.heading: Indian Employment visa requirements
sections.text: You need a job offer from a company or organisation in India, a contract or appointment letter, your qualifications, and documents from your employer. The role is usually expected to be skilled and to pay above a minimum salary, though some roles are exempt.

sections.heading: How long is an Indian Employment visa?
sections.text: It’s usually granted for up to a year, or the length of your contract if shorter, and can be extended in India.

sections.heading: How to apply for an Indian Employment visa
sections.text: Your employer sends your contract and their registration documents. We prepare your online form, check every document and tell you what to submit at the visa application centre. After you arrive, you usually register with the FRRO within 14 days.

faqs.q: Can I work in India on an e-Visa?
faqs.a: No. Paid work needs an Employment visa.

faqs.q: Does my employer need to do anything?
faqs.a: Yes. They provide your contract and their registration documents, and may need to support your registration after arrival.

faqs.q: Can I apply myself instead of using you?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. People use us when they want a person to check their eligibility, fix their photo and documents, and handle the form for them so nothing goes wrong.
